notes: Lifecycle-Aware Safe Merge. Prevents one-sided Product Inventory records from being blindly resurrected during phone/cloud conflict resolution. A record that exists on only one side is paused for review because absence may mean either a new record that has not synced yet or inventory that was already Used Up, Archived, Transferred Out, Shipped, Sold or Deleted. Adds One-Sided Inventory Review with Restore as Active or Keep Ended / Do Not Restore decisions and persistent inventory tombstones. Sync Now is guarded so Product Inventory cannot be overwritten while unresolved one-sided records remain. Legacy Build069 union-merge controls are disabled once Build070 loads. No database schema change; prior Hybrid Carpet Tag and Cut Piece Return fixes remain intact.
